clue.text: Judge, you say, sad about traitor

indicators.note: 'you say' asks for a word that, spoken, sounds like 'you'

parts.note: the word 'you' said aloud sounds like the letter U

indicators.note: 'about' tells us to turn the word sad round

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone calls a judge sad about a betrayer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns SAD into DAS, which follows J and U.
explanation.definitionFit: The disciple who betrayed Jesus has become the byword for any treacherous friend.

clue.text: Boy's all spit and polish-that's England

parts.note: John is a common boy's name
bull is old military slang for excessive spit and polish, fussy cleaning for show

explanation.surface: A lad who is all shine and parade typifies the English.
explanation.walkthrough: BULL as fussy military polishing is chiefly British slang.
explanation.definitionFit: The stout farmer figure is the traditional cartoon personification of the English nation.

clue.text: Tried to move to US city

indicators.note: the letters of 'Tried to' are made to move into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone attempted relocation to an American city.
explanation.definitionFit: The Michigan motor city is a major American metropolis.

clue.text: Toss coin in error

indicators.note: 'in' puts the coin's letter inside the word for error

parts.note: a sin is a wrongdoing or error
P stands for penny, a coin

explanation.surface: Flipping a coin goes wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: To flip a coin into the air is to give it a turn, as at the start of a match.

clue.text: Where Italians eat out of doors?

definitions.text: Where Italians eat out of doors?

parts.words: Where Italians eat out of doors?
parts.note: an Italian phrase meaning 'in the cool air', used in English for eating outside

explanation.surface: A question about where Italians take their meals outside.
explanation.definitionFit: The borrowed Italian phrase means dining or doing anything in the open air.

clue.text: Tolerant philosophy confounded all evident evil

indicators.note: confounded means thrown into confusion, so the letters of all evident evil are mixed up

explanation.surface: A tolerant outlook is upset by every visible wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: The motto urges accepting others' ways so that they accept yours, a creed of tolerance.

clue.text: Wrong gear for fashion

indicators.note: 'Wrong' signals the letters of gear put in the wrong order

explanation.surface: Wearing the wrong clothes is a fashion faux pas.
explanation.definitionFit: A craze or passing vogue is said to be all the rage.

clue.text: Eat a bird

definitions.meaning: to eat is to take food down the throat
a fork-tailed migrant bird of summer

explanation.definitionFit: Gulping food down is the verb sense; the fork-tailed summer migrant is the bird.

clue.text: Frequently is more malleable, removing top

indicators.note: in a down answer the top is the first letter, which is taken away

parts.note: to soften is to become more malleable

explanation.surface: Often it gets softer once you take the hard top off.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something many times is doing it frequently, a plain synonym.

clue.text: Malicious spirits recommend one to argue an unpopular cause

definitions.text: one to argue an unpopular cause

parts.note: devils are evil spirits
to advocate is to recommend or urge

explanation.surface: Evil spirits back a person who argues for the unpopular side.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who takes the contrary side for argument's sake, from the Vatican official opposing canonisation.

clue.text: Emergency phone for stolen stock of goods?

parts.note: hot is slang for stolen goods
a line is a range of goods a shop stocks

explanation.surface: A phone for reporting a stolen consignment.
explanation.definitionFit: A direct telephone link kept open for urgent calls, famously between Washington and Moscow.

clue.text: Old lady caught by tax becomes a beggar

indicators.note: 'caught by' puts the old lady inside the tax

parts.note: VAT is value added tax
an old lady can be a gran, a grandmother

explanation.surface: A grandmother hit by taxes ends up begging.
explanation.walkthrough: VAT is value added tax, the UK sales tax.
explanation.definitionFit: A homeless wanderer with no means is a tramp who begs.

clue.text: One making a mark afloat

parts.note: something floating that marks a channel or hazard at sea, not a person making a name

explanation.surface: Someone succeeding while at sea.
explanation.definitionFit: A floating marker anchored to show a channel or hazard to shipping.

clue.text: Girl to transport couch

parts.note: Di is a girl's name, short for Diana
a van is a vehicle for transport

explanation.surface: A girl arranges delivery of a sofa.
explanation.definitionFit: A low backless sofa or bed-settee.

clue.text: Tailless antelope makes dash

indicators.note: 'Tailless' says the antelope loses its final letter

parts.note: an eland is a large African antelope

explanation.surface: An antelope without a tail makes a run for it.
explanation.definitionFit: Dash as in verve or flair, a stylish vigour.

clue.text: Indian worker starts to dream happily of bigger income

indicators.note: 'starts to' takes the opening letter of each following word

explanation.surface: A labourer in India dreams of a better wage.
explanation.walkthrough: In India a dhobi is a washerman.
explanation.definitionFit: A washerman, a traditional laundry trade in India.

clue.text: Morally improve small boy, if I speak

parts.note: Ed is a short form of Edward, a boy

indicators.note: 'speak' says the words 'if I' are said out loud

parts.note: spoken, 'if I' runs together as the ending -ify

explanation.surface: Teach a little lad better, if I may say.
explanation.definitionFit: To instruct someone in a way that uplifts them morally or intellectually.

clue.text: Make comparatively poor effort to get at contents of lorry?

definitions.meaning: to perform worse than teammates and so disappoint them

definitions.text: to get at contents of lorry?
definitions.meaning: literally, lower the flap at the side of a truck to unload it

explanation.definitionFit: Failing your team is the idiom; lowering a truck's flap to unload is the literal sense.

clue.text: Looked round the church, very formal

indicators.note: 'round' puts the stare around the church letters

parts.note: stared means looked hard

explanation.surface: Someone gazed around the church, stiff and proper.
explanation.definitionFit: Stiff in manner, like a collar stiffened with laundry starch.

clue.text: Put on a strange diet? For Adam, it was an apple

definitions.text: Put on a strange diet? For Adam, it was an apple

parts.words: Put on a strange diet? For Adam, it was an apple
parts.note: playful hint at food that is barred, as in Eden where Adam ate what God prohibited

explanation.surface: A strange diet was imposed; for Adam, the item was an apple.
explanation.definitionFit: The fruit God prohibited in Eden, now any tempting pleasure that is not allowed.

clue.text: Propose motion? He would do the converse

indicators.note: 'motion' signals the letters of Propose set in motion into a new order

explanation.surface: A debater proposes a motion while another speaks against it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'motion' looks like the debate's motion, but it signals the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: A debater on the other side argues the reverse of the proposer.

clue.text: First to understand the symbol for this bomb component

definitions.text: First to understand the symbol for this bomb component

parts.words: First to understand the symbol for this bomb component
parts.note: the first letter of 'understand' is the chemical symbol of the radioactive element used in atom bombs

explanation.surface: A bomb's inner part needs its symbol understood first.
explanation.definitionFit: The radioactive metal, chemical symbol U, is the fissile fuel of early atomic bombs.

clue.text: Successfully manage one end of telescope

indicators.note: 'one end of' takes the final stretch of letters of the word telescope

explanation.surface: Handle one end of a telescope well.
explanation.definitionFit: To deal adequately with a difficulty is to manage it.

clue.text: Muddle as Charles gets nothing to eat

indicators.note: 'to eat' puts nothing inside the short form of Charles

parts.note: O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Confusion reigns while Charles goes without food.
explanation.definitionFit: A state of complete disorder or confusion.

clue.text: Pattern of fungus?

definitions.meaning: a shape or template from which copies are made
a furry growth of fungi on damp or old things

explanation.definitionFit: A template for casting shapes, and the furry growth on stale food.

clue.text: A quiet song or two

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for quietly
an air is a tune or song

explanation.surface: A soft tune or a duet.
explanation.definitionFit: A couple or brace, a set of two.

clue.text: Jenny who went to sea

definitions.meaning: Jenny is a folk name for the small brown bird
a member of the Women's Royal Naval Service

explanation.walkthrough: The Women's Royal Naval Service was Britain's naval service for women.
explanation.definitionFit: Jenny is the folk name for the tiny brown songbird; a woman in the naval service was also so called.

clue.text: Badly-behaved youngster has right to enter club

indicators.note: 'to enter' puts right inside the club

parts.note: a bat is a club for hitting a ball

explanation.surface: A naughty child gets the right to join a club.
explanation.definitionFit: A spoilt, ill-mannered child.

clue.text: One country expelling a student-to this one?

indicators.note: 'expelling' means the a and the student are thrown out of the country

parts.note: a country here is Australia
L for learner, a student driver

explanation.surface: A nation throws out a student, sending them to another.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is 'this one', the country the clue arrives at.
explanation.definitionFit: Another country, the Alpine republic produced by the wordplay.

clue.text: Artist's final work shows a superficial improvement

definitions.meaning: the clear protective coat a painter adds last
a gloss that only makes something look better

explanation.definitionFit: The glossy coat a painter applies last, and figuratively a cosmetic gloss.

clue.text: Spaniel-vocalist gives home to a pair

indicators.note: 'gives home to' puts the pair inside the singer

parts.note: a vocalist is a singer
PR is the abbreviation for pair

explanation.surface: A singer takes in a couple of lodgers.
explanation.definitionFit: A breed of spaniel used to flush game.

clue.text: Most of time, I would appear shy

indicators.note: 'Most of' means all but the last letter of time

parts.note: taken as written
I'd is the contraction of I would

explanation.surface: Most of the time I would seem bashful.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacking confidence, easily frightened.
